questions.questionText: A company uses a pre-trained large language model (LLM). The LLM must carry out multiple tasks that need specific domain knowledge. The LLM lacks information about several technical topics in that domain. The company has unlabeled data it can use to fine-tune the model. Which fine-tuning method meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: Continued pre-training extends a foundation model’s pre-training with additional unlabeled text from a particular domain, allowing it to learn domain-specific knowledge and terminology. Supervised fine-tuning instead requires labeled input-output pairs, while retrieval-augmented generation is not a fine-tuning method.
learnMore: Continued pre-training (CPT) - Amazon Nova

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company trains image- and text-generation models on Amazon SageMaker AI. The company releases the models using Amazon Bedrock. The company must keep a tamper-proof, queryable record of every API call from SageMaker AI, Amazon Bedrock, and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudTrail Lake stores CloudTrail events in immutable event data stores and supports SQL-based queries. CloudTrail captures AWS API activity, enabling an auditable, tamper-resistant record of management API calls across services such as Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Bedrock, and IAM.
learnMore: Working with AWS CloudTrail Lake
CloudTrail Lake concepts and terminology

questions.questionText: A company uses Amazon Comprehend to analyze customer feedback. A customer has multiple uniquely trained models, and the company assigns an endpoint to each model by using Comprehend. The company wants to automate a report for every endpoint that has not been used for more than 15 days. Which service meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor includes an Amazon Comprehend underutilized-endpoints cost-optimization check. It flags endpoints that have not been actively used for real-time inference requests for more than 15 days, and its results refresh automatically each day.
learnMore: Using Trusted Advisor with Amazon Comprehend

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A financial company uses an ML model to identify potentially fraudulent transactions. The company must ensure that certain prediction types are reviewed by human analysts before it acts on those predictions. Which AWS solution meets this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) adds human review loops to ML workflows, allowing selected model predictions to be routed to human reviewers before a downstream action is taken.
learnMore: Using Amazon Augmented AI for Human Review

questions.questionText: A company is building a large language model (LLM) question answering chatbot. The company wants to decrease the number of actions call center employees need to take to respond to customer questions. Which business objective should the company use to evaluate the effect of the LLM chatbot?
questions.explanation: Average call duration is the most direct metric for measuring whether the chatbot reduces employee workload. Shorter calls indicate the chatbot is effectively assisting or resolving customer inquiries more quickly, directly reflecting the business objective of reducing employee actions. Website engagement rate, CSR initiatives, and regulatory compliance are not aligned with the stated goal of reducing call center work.

questions.questionText: A company employs an Amazon Bedrock large language model (LLM) in an application. During testing, the company notices different outputs for the same input. What is the MOST likely cause of this issue?
options: A. The LLM is acting in a nondeterministic way.
B. The guardrails of the LLM are not configured properly.
C. The LLM has security vulnerabilities.
D. The LLM is acting in a deterministic way.
questions.explanation: LLMs can behave nondeterministically because they sample from probability distributions when generating tokens. Amazon Bedrock inference settings such as temperature and top-p control that randomness; higher randomness can produce different responses for the identical prompt.

questions.questionText: A company needs to classify images of different objects using custom features extracted from a dataset. Which solution meets this requirement with the LEAST development effort?
options: A. Use traditional ML algorithms with custom features extracted from the dataset.
B. Use a pre-trained deep learning model. Fine-tune the model on the dataset.
C. Use a generative adversarial network (GAN) model to classify the images.
D. Use a support vector machine (SVM) with manually engineered features for classification.
questions.explanation: Traditional machine-learning algorithms can directly use the extracted custom features for classification, avoiding the additional work of selecting, adapting, and fine-tuning a deep-learning model. A GAN is primarily intended for generative tasks, while manually engineering features for an SVM is unnecessary when suitable custom features have already been extracted.
learnMore: Difference between ML and deep learning (AWS)
What is deep learning? (AWS)

questions.questionText: A company has built a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)-based AI assistant using Amazon Bedrock Agents. At times, the AI assistant produces incomplete or inaccurate answers. The company wants to enhance and assess the AI assistant's performance. Which solution will satisfy these requirements?
options: A. Use automated metrics such as Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) scores to measure response similarity to reference answers.
B. Monitor response latency and token generation speed to optimize performance.
C. Evaluate only the final answer quality against ground truth responses.
D. Confirm that the retrieved documents are relevant and that the final answers are accurate.
questions.explanation: RAG quality depends on both retrieving context that is relevant to the request and generating an accurate answer grounded in that context. Amazon Bedrock RAG evaluations provide retrieval metrics such as context relevance and response metrics such as correctness, completeness, and faithfulness, allowing faults in either stage to be identified and improved.
learnMore: Use metrics to understand RAG system performance

questions.questionText: A company has developed an ML model for image classification. The company wants to deploy the model to production so that a web application can use the model. The company needs to implement a solution to host the model and serve predictions without managing any of the underlying infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?
options: A. Use Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference to deploy the model.
B. Use Amazon CloudFront to deploy the model.
C. Use Amazon API Gateway to host the model and serve predictions.
D. Use AWS Batch to host the model and serve predictions.
questions.explanation: Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference provides fully managed, infrastructure-agnostic model deployment with automatic scaling based on request volume—eliminating the need to provision or manage EC2 instances or other compute resources. The web application submits predictions requests, and the service handles all infrastructure provisioning. CloudFront is a CDN; API Gateway routes traffic; AWS Batch processes batch workloads—none eliminate infrastructure management.
learnMore: Deploy models with Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference

questions.questionText: A company maintains a large product catalog containing detailed descriptions. The company wants to create an AI assistant that answers customer product questions, but its labeled training data is limited. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?
options: A. Use a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to query the product database at runtime. Provide relevant, unmodified product descriptions as context for the foundation model (FM).
B. Fine-tune a foundation model (FM) on the restricted labeled data. Automatically refresh the model with novel product details weekly for accuracy.
C. Deploy a foundation model (FM) for each product category. Implement a routing layer to direct customer queries to the appropriate specialized model.
D. Create a new custom foundation model (FM) that is trained on the product database. Optimize the FM for minimal token usage during inference.
questions.explanation: Retrieval Augmented Generation retrieves relevant product descriptions from the catalog at runtime and provides them as context to a foundation model. This grounds responses in current, domain-specific data without requiring labeled-data fine-tuning, periodic model retraining, category-specific model deployment, or training a custom foundation model.
learnMore: What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation?

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A global logistics company uses generative AI (GenAI) models on Amazon Bedrock to automate paperwork and shipment documentation. The company wants to establish a clear AI governance process to ensure that the models are used responsibly and comply with company policies. Which solutions meet these requirements? Choose two
options: A. Set up a regular review process to check that the models' results are accurate and fair and follow company policies.
B. Provide training for all employees who work with AI tools so the employees understand company rules, data handling, and responsible AI use.
C. Let the cloud provider manage all AI safety checks and reviews to save internal effort.
D. Involve only developers in governance reviews because the developers build and deploy the AI systems.
E. Review the models only when users report problems or errors in the system.
questions.explanation: Effective AI governance requires continuous, human-led review of model behavior for reliability, fairness, and conformance with organizational policies. It also requires that employees using AI understand applicable policies, proper data handling, and responsible-use practices. AWS responsible-AI guidance calls for regular review processes, governance involving technical, business, and risk-management perspectives, and human oversight of monitored systems.
learnMore: Responsible AI - Generative AI Lens

questions.questionText: A company wants to assess the costs that are associated with using a large language model (LLM) to generate inferences. The company wants to use Amazon Bedrock to build generative AI applications. Which factor will drive the inference costs?
options: C. Amount of data used to train the LLM
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock inference costs are driven by the number of tokens consumed (both input and output). Temperature, training data volume, and training time do not directly affect inference costs.

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company running AI workloads on Amazon Bedrock must evaluate and document compliance with regulatory standards. Which AWS service or feature fulfills these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Audit Manager helps continuously collect audit evidence and assess AWS usage against regulatory frameworks, enabling organizations to evaluate and document compliance.
learnMore: What is AWS Audit Manager?
Compliance validation for AWS Audit Manager

questions.questionText: A company needs to identify customer groups using customers’ demographics and purchasing patterns. Which algorithm should the company use to satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanation: K-means is an unsupervised clustering algorithm that forms discrete groups of similar observations from their attributes, making it suitable for customer segmentation by demographics and purchasing behavior. Amazon SageMaker AI K-Means Algorithm

questions.questionText: A company has created a neural network model to replace an existing decision tree model. The neural network model achieves higher prediction accuracy than the decision tree model. However, the neural network model’s decision-making process is less explainable than that of the decision tree model. Which tradeoff is the company making by adopting the neural network model?
options: A. Higher compliance for lower interpretability
B. Higher performance for lower portability
C. Higher performance for lower interpretability
D. Higher portability for lower interpretability
questions.explanation: The neural network provides higher predictive performance, measured by prediction accuracy, while sacrificing interpretability because its decision process is less transparent than a decision tree’s.
learnMore: AI Practitioner exam guide - Domain 4: Guidelines for Responsible AI
Model transparency (AWS whitepaper)

questions.questionText: A company plans to use large language models (LLMs) to build a chatbot. The chatbot will help customers with product inquiries, order tracking, and returns. It must be able to process text and image inputs to generate responses. Which AWS service fulfills these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock provides managed access to foundation models, including multimodal models that can process text and image inputs and generate responses for conversational applications such as customer-support chatbots.

questions.questionText: A company is developing an AI assistant application and must implement a core governance process for the development project. The company must ensure that the application follows responsible AI practices.
questions.explanation: Responsible-AI governance begins by translating principles into concrete goals, assessing risks, and defining policies. A cross-functional group then provides ownership and oversight across legal, security, product, and engineering concerns. Continuous model monitoring follows to identify operational, safety, fairness, and compliance issues and to improve governance over the application lifecycle.
learnMore: Govern AI - Cloud Adoption Framework
Responsible AI Policies - Cloud Adoption Framework

questions.questionText: A company wants to build a chatbot that answers employee questions about company policies. The policies are updated often, and the chatbot must reflect those changes in near real time. The company wants to select a large language model (LLM). Which solution satisfies these requirements?
options: A. Fine-tune an LLM on the company policy text by using Amazon SageMaker.
B. Select a foundation model (FM) from Amazon Bedrock to build an application.
C. Create a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) workflow by using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
D. Use Amazon Q Business to build a custom Q App.
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases provides a managed Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) workflow that retrieves relevant proprietary policy content when a user asks a question. Its data sources can be synchronized incrementally so added, modified, and deleted policy documents are re-indexed without retraining or fine-tuning the LLM.
learnMore: Retrieve data and generate AI responses with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases
Sync your data with your Amazon Bedrock knowledge base

questions.questionText: An airline company plans to use a generative AI model to convert a flight-booking system from one programming language to another. The company must choose a model for this task. Which criteria should the company use to select the appropriate generative AI model for this task?
options: A. Syntax, semantic understanding, and code optimization capabilities
B. Code generation speed and error handling capabilities
C. Ability to generate creative content
D. Model size and resource requirements
questions.explanation: Programming-language conversion depends on correctly understanding source-code syntax and semantics and generating equivalent, optimized code in the target language.
learnMore: Transforming code with Amazon Q Developer

questions.questionText: A company is evaluating Amazon Nova models in Amazon Bedrock. The company requires a multimodal model that supports multiple languages. Which Nova model meets these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?
questions.explanation: Amazon Nova Lite processes text, image, and video inputs, supports the multilingual capabilities of the Nova understanding models, and is AWS’s low-cost multimodal model. Nova Pro is a more capable but higher-cost multimodal option, while Nova Canvas and Nova Reel are specialized image and video generation models.
learnMore: Nova Lite - Amazon Bedrock
Introducing Amazon Nova foundation models

questions.questionText: A company wants to use language models to create an application for inference on edge devices. The inference must have the lowest latency possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?
options: A. Deploy optimized small language models (SLMs) on edge devices.
B. Deploy optimized large language models (LLMs) on edge devices.
C. Incorporate a centralized small language model (SLM) API for asynchronous communication with edge devices.
D. Incorporate a centralized large language model (LLM) API for asynchronous communication with edge devices.
questions.explanation: Deploying optimized small language models on edge devices achieves the lowest latency because inference happens locally without network round trips. SLMs are lightweight and designed to run efficiently within device resource constraints, whereas centralized LLM APIs introduce network latency that contradicts the lowest-latency requirement.
learnMore: Running small language models at the edge
Machine learning on edge devices

questions.questionText: A company plans to build an AI assistant that responds to user queries. The AI assistant must assess particular data sources, call external APIs, generate response choices, and compare and prioritize those choices. Which Amazon Bedrock feature or resource meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock Agents orchestrate interactions among foundation models, data sources, software applications, and user conversations. They can query knowledge bases and invoke external APIs through action groups as part of a multi-step orchestration process, enabling the assistant to generate and prioritize an appropriate response.
learnMore: Automate tasks in your application using AI agents - Amazon Bedrock
How Amazon Bedrock Agents works

questions.questionText: Which metric is used to assess the performance of foundation models (FMs) for text-summarization tasks?
questions.explanation: BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy) score measures text generation quality by computing n-gram overlap precision between machine-generated summaries and human reference summaries, with a brevity penalty for overly short outputs. BLEU is widely used for evaluating text generation tasks including summarization. F1 score (A) is for classification, accuracy (C) lacks the granularity needed for generation tasks, and MSE (D) is for regression—none are appropriate for summarization evaluation.
learnMore: Text summarization for model evaluation in Amazon Bedrock

questions.questionText: A company developed an AI-powered resume-screening system. The company used a large dataset to train the model. The dataset included resumes that did not represent all demographics. Which core dimension of responsible AI is presented by this scenario?
questions.explanation: Fairness requires AI systems to avoid unjustified bias and disparate outcomes among demographic groups. Training on resumes that underrepresent some demographics can cause the screening model to perform less equitably for those groups.
learnMore: Core dimensions of responsible AI for Amazon Bedrock applications

questions.questionText: A company is using domain-specific models. The company wants to avoid creating new models from the beginning. The company instead wants to adapt pre-trained models to create models for new, related tasks. Which ML strategy meets these requirements?
options: A. Increase the number of epochs.
C. Decrease the number of epochs.
questions.explanation: Transfer learning leverages pre-trained models that already possess general knowledge, then fine-tunes them on domain-specific data for new but related tasks. This approach avoids building from scratch, saving time and computational resources. Adjusting training epochs, using unsupervised learning, and other options do not address the core requirement of adapting existing models.
learnMore: What is Transfer Learning?

questions.questionText: Which result follows from increasing a model’s transparency?
options: A. Reduced need for model validation steps
B. Elimination of regulatory compliance monitoring requirements
C. Automatic removal of all bias from model predictions
D. Enhanced ability to identify bias and improve model governance
questions.explanation: Greater model transparency enables stakeholders to inspect model behavior more effectively, identify potential bias, and improve governance and oversight practices.
learnMore: Model transparency (AWS whitepaper)
Responsible AI (AWS)

questions.questionText: A company is building a customer service chatbot. The company wants the chatbot to improve its responses by learning from past interactions and online resources. Which AI learning strategy provides this self-improvement capability?
options: A. Supervised learning with a manually curated dataset of good responses and bad responses
B. Reinforcement learning with rewards for positive customer feedback
C. Unsupervised learning to find clusters of similar customer inquiries
D. Supervised learning with a continuously updated FAQ database
questions.explanation: Reinforcement learning with rewards enables continuous self-improvement: the chatbot learns by receiving positive feedback for helpful responses and adjusting its behavior accordingly. This allows autonomous improvement from past interactions without manual dataset updates.
learnMore: What is RLHF? (AWS)

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A hospital is developing an AI system to help doctors diagnose diseases using patient records and medical images. To comply with regulations, sensitive patient data must remain in the country where the data is located. Which data-governance strategy will ensure compliance and protect patient privacy?
questions.explanation: Data residency requires data to be stored and handled within a specified geographic jurisdiction. Keeping sensitive patient records and medical images in their country of origin supports location-based regulatory requirements and helps protect patient privacy.
learnMore: Addressing data residency with AWS

questions.questionText: A company is using an Amazon Bedrock base model to summarize documents for an internal use case. The company trained a custom model to improve the summarization quality. Which action must the company take to use the custom model through Amazon Bedrock?
options: A. Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model.
B. Deploy the custom model in an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time inference.
C. Register the model with the Amazon SageMaker Model Registry.
D. Grant access to the custom model in Amazon Bedrock.
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock does not support on-demand inference for customized (fine-tuned or continued pre-trained) models — a company must purchase Provisioned Throughput before it can invoke its custom model at all, so this purchase is the mandatory action required to actually use it. Granting model access in the console applies to base models offered by AWS and third-party providers, not to a private custom model that already belongs to the account, so it is not the blocking step here.
learnMore: Purchase Provisioned Throughput for a custom model

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company is training a foundation model (FM). It wants the FM training data to be managed effectively, securely, and compliantly throughout the data lifecycle. The data must adhere to governance practices. Which option is an AWS data-governance strategy for managing data across its lifecycle?
options: A. Allow unrestricted access to all data for every employee.
B. Store data indefinitely without classification or retention policies.
C. Rely solely on manual reviews for data quality and compliance.
D. Establish data lifecycle policies, access controls, logging, and monitoring.
questions.explanation: Data governance across a data lifecycle uses lifecycle and retention policies to govern handling and disposal, access controls to limit data use, and logging and monitoring to provide auditability and detect security or compliance issues. AWS Well-Architected guidance specifically includes retention periods, access, auditing, and continuous monitoring as data-lifecycle considerations.

questions.questionText: Which strategy can evaluate the performance of a foundation model (FM) in real-world applications?
options: A. Conducting A/B testing with users in a controlled environment
B. Human evaluation by subject matter experts
C. Measuring the model’s accuracy on a training dataset
D. Analysis of the model’s internal representations and attention patterns
questions.explanation: Human evaluation by subject-matter experts assesses whether model outputs are accurate, relevant, useful, and appropriate for the domain and intended application. Amazon Bedrock supports human-based evaluations using employees or industry subject-matter experts to rate model responses.
learnMore: Evaluate the performance of Amazon Bedrock resources

questions.questionText: A company is designing a customer-service chatbot using a fine-tuned large language model (LLM). The company wants the chatbot to use responsible AI characteristics.
questions.explanation: Anonymizing personal data protects training data, which is part of privacy and security. Explainable decisions let stakeholders understand and evaluate system outputs, which is transparency. Amazon Bedrock Guardrails filters harmful inputs and outputs and helps prevent misuse, which is safety.
learnMore: Detect and filter harmful content by using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails

questions.questionText: A company must deploy AI agents created with different frameworks and models on a flexible infrastructure. Which Amazon Bedrock feature fulfills these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore provides a managed platform for deploying and operating AI agents at scale with any agent framework and foundation model. Its Runtime supplies secure, serverless infrastructure for hosting those agents, satisfying both framework/model flexibility and deployment needs.
learnMore: What is Amazon Bedrock AgentCore?
Host agent or tools with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime

questions.questionText: A financial services company is rolling out an AI customer-support system to manage product inquiries. As it introduces new products and revises policies, the system must keep functioning effectively without needing to be rebuilt. Which AI characteristic is necessary for this use case?
options: B. Adaptability to incorporate updated information
D. Reliability in handling high-volume requests
questions.explanation: Adaptability enables an AI system to incorporate new product details and policy changes so it remains effective as its operating information evolves, without requiring a complete rebuild.

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company must share a dataset with a third-party provider. The provider will use that dataset to build an ML model. Some dataset fields include personally identifiable information (PII). The company requires a way to share the dataset without revealing PII. Which solution meets these requirements?
options: A. Apply data masking to all fields in the dataset.
B. Apply data masking to the fields that contain PII in the dataset.
C. Apply data encryption to all fields in the dataset.
D. Apply data labeling to the fields that contain PII in the dataset.
questions.explanation: Data masking applied to the fields containing PII obfuscates those sensitive values before sharing while retaining the non-PII fields needed to build the ML model. AWS Glue DataBrew documents masking as a mechanism to obfuscate PII during data preparation, and AWS guidance recommends masking PII so models do not process or retain raw sensitive information.

questions.questionText: A company is developing a generative AI (GenAI) application. The company wants to implement mechanisms that monitor and steer AI system behavior. Which responsible AI dimension is the company applying?
questions.explanation: Controllability is the responsible AI dimension concerned with mechanisms that monitor and steer AI system behavior.
learnMore: Responsible AI – AWS Generative AI Lens

questions.questionText: A retail company has deployed an ML model to predict whether customers will purchase a product. The dataset is highly imbalanced: only 5% of customers make purchases. The model has 95% accuracy; however, the company reports that it rarely identifies real buyers. Which metric should the company use instead to assess the model's performance?
options: C. Training time for each epoch
D. Cost for each inference request
questions.explanation: For a highly imbalanced purchase-prediction dataset, overall accuracy can remain high even when the model misses nearly all actual buyers. The F1 score balances precision and recall for the positive class, making it a more meaningful measure of buyer identification performance.

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company is building a customer service agent using Amazon Bedrock. The company needs to ensure that the agent does not reveal personally identifiable information (PII) in conversations with users. Which Amazon Bedrock feature satisfies these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails includes sensitive information filters that detect personally identifiable information (PII) in user inputs and model responses and can block or mask it, preventing the agent from disclosing PII.
learnMore: Detect and filter harmful content by using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails

questions.questionText: A startup is developing a generative AI (GenAI)-powered AI assistant on Amazon Bedrock. The company wants to reduce upfront costs while tailoring model responses for users. Which strategy satisfies these requirements?
questions.explanation: Prompt engineering tailors a foundation model’s responses by optimizing the input instructions at inference time, without training a custom model. This avoids the training and storage costs associated with fine-tuning or pre-training, making it the lowest-upfront-cost approach for shaping response behavior.
learnMore: Prompt engineering concepts - Amazon Bedrock

questions.questionText: A company is building an AI assistant using Amazon Q Developer with the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The company needs to understand MCP components and their functions.
questions.explanation: In MCP architecture, the host is the AI application environment and coordinator. The host creates MCP clients, which establish and manage isolated connections to servers. MCP servers provide the specialized context and capabilities, exposing resources, prompts, and tools.
learnMore: Model Context Protocol architecture
Model Context Protocol specification

questions.questionText: A company plans to build a customer-facing generative AI application. The application must block or mask sensitive information and must detect hallucinations. Which solution satisfies these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: A. Use AWS Lambda functions to build a policy evaluator.
B. Select a foundation model (FM) that includes policies that remove harmful content by default.
C. Use Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to implement safeguards for the application based on use cases.
D. Host a custom build policy evaluator on Amazon EC2 instances.
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails provides configurable sensitive-information filters that can block or mask sensitive data in prompts and model responses, plus contextual grounding checks that detect hallucinated responses. Because Guardrails is managed by Amazon Bedrock, it requires less operational effort than building and hosting a custom policy evaluator.
learnMore: Detect and filter harmful content by using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
Use contextual grounding check to filter hallucinations in responses

questions.questionText: A company requires a generative AI (GenAI) application to explain its reasoning steps before providing final answers. Which prompt-engineering technique meets this requirement?
questions.explanation: Chain-of-thought prompting directs a model to reason through intermediate steps before producing its final answer, making the reasoning process transparent and easier to follow.
learnMore: Give Amazon Nova time to think (chain-of-thought)

questions.questionText: A team uses Amazon SageMaker AI to create article summaries and translate those summaries into other languages. The team has human reference translations for every language. The team requires an automated metric to assess the quality of the model’s translations against those references across the languages. Which evaluation metric meets these requirements?
options: A. Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE)
C. Area Under the ROC Curve (ROC)
questions.explanation: BLEU measures n-gram overlap between generated translations and human reference translations, with a brevity penalty, making it a standard automatic metric for machine-translation quality across languages. Amazon SageMaker AI supports BLEU as a sequence-to-sequence validation metric.
learnMore: Tune a Sequence-to-Sequence Model - Amazon SageMaker AI

questions.questionText: A company develops applications on AWS. The company wants to use a foundation model (FM) to improve developer productivity by reducing the time required to write application code. Which solution will satisfy these requirements?
options: A. Use Amazon Q Developer to generate real-time inline code suggestions.
B. Create an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to generate real-time inline code suggestions.
C. Use Amazon CodeGuru to generate real-time inline code suggestions.
D. Use Amazon Personalize to generate real-time in line code suggestions.
questions.explanation: Amazon Q Developer provides real-time inline code recommendations while developers write code, helping reduce the effort and time needed for application development.
learnMore: Generating inline suggestions with Amazon Q Developer

questions.questionText: A travel agency is building an application to automate the process of making travel reservations for customers. The application will use an Amazon Bedrock model. It must orchestrate multiple actions and API calls to interpret customer input and generate reservation outputs. Which AWS service or feature fulfills these requirements?
questions.explanation: Agents for Amazon Bedrock can interpret customer input, coordinate multi-step workflows, and use action groups to invoke APIs needed to complete tasks such as travel reservations.
learnMore: Automate tasks in your application using AI agents - Amazon Bedrock
How Amazon Bedrock Agents works

questions.questionText: A generative AI application produces inaccurate information. Which term describes this problem?
questions.explanation: A hallucination is generated content that is false, fabricated, or unsupported by the model’s input or reliable facts.

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A financial services company has built an AI model using AWS to help review customer loan applications. Regulatory transparency requirements mean the company must be able to explain how the model reaches its decisions. Which AWS service or feature meets this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon SageMaker Clarify provides model explainability through feature attributions, showing why a model made a prediction for a particular application. These explanations support auditing, transparency, and regulatory compliance in lending use cases.
learnMore: Model Explainability - Amazon SageMaker AI

questions.questionText: A financial services company uses a generative AI (GenAI) model to generate personalized investment summaries. The company is concerned that the model could present persuasive but factually inaccurate financial information to customers. Which GenAI limitation accounts for this concern?
options: A. Limited access to real-time market data feeds without explicit integration
B. Possibility of generating plausible-sounding but potentially false information
C. Inability to automatically apply regulatory compliance frameworks without added controls
D. Limited capability to personalize content for individual customers at scale
questions.explanation: Generative AI models can hallucinate by producing plausible-sounding information that is false or unsupported. Fluency and apparent confidence do not guarantee factual accuracy, including for financial content.

questions.questionText: A company plans to use Amazon SageMaker AI to help conduct monthly customer-satisfaction assessments. The workload is not time-sensitive, and the company does not want persistent endpoints. Which inference option meets these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?
questions.explanation: Amazon SageMaker AI Batch Transform is intended for offline inference on data available in batches when a persistent endpoint is unnecessary. It provisions compute for the batch job and charges for that job’s duration, making it suitable for a monthly, non-time-sensitive assessment workload.
learnMore: Inference cost optimization best practices - Amazon SageMaker AI
Inference options in Amazon SageMaker AI

questions.questionText: A company has deployed a generative AI (GenAI) application. It has observed that identical prompts can sometimes yield different responses, and that the responses occasionally contain false information. Which issues does this scenario represent? Choose two
questions.explanation: Generative AI models can be nondeterministic: the same input may produce different outputs across invocations. False or fabricated information in a model response is a hallucination.

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company must scan its Amazon EC2-based ML infrastructure for security vulnerabilities before it deploys generative AI (GenAI) models. Which AWS service offers automated vulnerability assessment?
questions.explanation: Amazon Inspector automatically discovers and continually scans Amazon EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure, producing findings for identified issues.
learnMore: What is Amazon Inspector?
Scanning Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon Inspector

questions.questionText: A company wants its AI assistant to check current inventory levels in the company’s warehouse system. Which option enables the AI assistant to access real-time data from external systems?
questions.explanation: Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets an AI assistant use tools supplied by external systems, such as a warehouse inventory API, so it can retrieve current data at request time. RAG is intended to retrieve indexed content, while fine-tuning and prompt engineering do not provide external-system access.
learnMore: Developer quickstart – OpenAI API

questions.questionText: A financial company must create automated, text-based investment summaries for client portfolios. The model must generate the investment summaries within seconds and preserve a specific formatting style across all client communications. It must also uphold the company’s financial-reporting accuracy standards. Which AI model capability meets these requirements?
options: A. Inference latency with regulatory compliance and consistency capabilities
B. Multimodal capabilities with image generation features
C. Code generation capability with programming syntax features
D. Conversational chat features with dialogue management capabilities
questions.explanation: Low-latency inference supports generating summaries within seconds, while consistency and regulatory-compliance capabilities support standardized client-facing formatting and controlled, accurate financial-reporting outputs. Financial-services generative-AI workloads should be evaluated against latency constraints, regulatory adherence, response consistency, and financial-domain accuracy.

questions.questionText: An AI practitioner is developing a model and has collected data for it. Which step should the AI practitioner take next?
questions.explanation: Data preprocessing prepares collected data for model training by cleaning, transforming, partitioning, scaling, or otherwise improving its quality and format. Model tuning and evaluation require prepared data, and drift monitoring is a post-deployment activity.
learnMore: Data preprocessing - Machine Learning Lens
Well-Architected machine learning lifecycle - Machine Learning Lens

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company must automate recurring compliance assessments for its AI workloads. The assessments need documented evidence mapped to regulatory frameworks. Which AWS service satisfies these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Audit Manager automates the collection and organization of audit evidence for ongoing assessments. Its prebuilt and customizable frameworks contain controls mapped to compliance standards and regulations, supporting evidence-based compliance reviews.
learnMore: What is AWS Audit Manager?

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company is getting ready for a compliance review. It requires an AWS service that automatically gathers information from the company's AWS accounts and produces reports for reviewers. Which AWS service fulfills these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Audit Manager automatically collects audit evidence from the AWS accounts included in an assessment and produces assessment reports containing selected evidence for auditors and reviewers.
learnMore: What is AWS Audit Manager?
Preparing an assessment report in AWS Audit Manager

questions.questionText: A company assesses a medical AI model by comparing its predictions with a labeled dataset of radiology reports to measure diagnostic accuracy. Which evaluation method is the company using?
questions.explanation: Domain-specific benchmark testing evaluates a model against labeled examples and performance criteria drawn from its intended subject area. A labeled radiology-report dataset measures diagnostic accuracy within the medical domain.

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A company uses Amazon SageMaker AI to create dashboards that use customer data. The company gathers customer data from multiple countries. To satisfy AWS data-governance requirements, the company must comply with rules governing where data is stored and processed. Which solution is consistent with AWS data-residency practices?
options: A. Store and process customer data in the AWS Region where the data was originally collected.
B. Move all customer data to a single AWS Region for management and analysis.
C. Copy all data across multiple AWS Regions to improve access speed for global teams.
D. Delete all data after analysis to avoid long-term storage concerns.
questions.explanation: AWS data residency practices require customer data to remain stored and processed in the AWS Region or Regions chosen to satisfy the applicable geographic requirements. Keeping data in the Region associated with where it was collected avoids unnecessary cross-Region transfers that could violate localization requirements.

questions.questionText: A retail company needs to recognize its products in images across social-media applications. Which model type meets these requirements?
options: D. Multimodal understanding large language model (LLM)
questions.explanation: Multimodal understanding LLMs can analyze image inputs and determine what objects or products are present by combining visual understanding with language capabilities. Vision-enabled multimodal models are designed to analyze images and respond to questions about their contents.
learnMore: Use vision-enabled chat models

questions.questionText: A company needs to train a large language model (LLM) to produce natural-language text for technical manuals. Which solution meets this requirement with the LEAST development effort?
options: A. Fine-tune a pre-trained LLM on domain-specific data.
B. Train a new LLM on domain-specific data.
C. Create specialized prompts for a pre-trained, general purpose LLM.
D. Fine-tune a pre-trained LLM on an up-to-date general text dataset.
questions.explanation: Well-engineered prompts can adapt a pre-trained foundation model to a desired task and output style without modifying model weights or preparing and running a training job. Fine-tuning is appropriate only when prompting does not sufficiently address domain-specific requirements, and training a new LLM requires far greater development effort.
learnMore: Foundation model customization — Amazon SageMaker AI

questions.questionText: Which scenario suggests that an ML model is overfitting?
options: A. A stock prediction model decreases in accuracy after testing on new data.
B. A loan default risk model uses only credit scores to assess risk.
C. A sales prediction model uses only one month to forecast yearly revenue.
D. A student performance model uses only the number of advanced classes that a student has taken to assess performance.
questions.explanation: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too closely and consequently performs poorly on new, unseen data. A decline in accuracy on new data is therefore an indicator of overfitting.

questions.questionText: A company develops electronic-record software. Users occasionally enter incomplete sentences into the records. The company wants to use ML to automatically finish those sentences. Which solution satisfies these requirements?
options: A. Use a large language model (LLM) trained on data from the records.
B. Use a computer vision model trained on images and related metadata.
C. Use a k-nearest neighbors (k-NN) algorithm to classify input terms.
D. Use reinforcement learning with input data to produce full sentences.
questions.explanation: A large language model trained on record data can model language context and generate a likely continuation for an incomplete sentence. Computer vision analyzes images, k-NN is primarily a similarity-based classification method, and reinforcement learning is not the standard approach for directly completing text.

questions.questionText: A customer-support AI assistant includes the identical system prompt in every request to Amazon Nova Micro, resulting in high cost and latency. Which solution optimizes these repetitive system prompts without changing the model?
options: A. Fine-tune the model to permanently embed the system instructions.
B. Use prompt caching with checkpoints for the inference.
C. Implement guardrails to store and reuse the system prompts for every inference.
D. Use a knowledge base to load system prompts from Amazon S3.
questions.explanation: Amazon Bedrock prompt caching reduces inference response latency and input-token costs for frequently reused prompt content. Amazon Nova Micro supports explicit prompt caching, including cache checkpoints in the system and messages fields, allowing a static system-prompt prefix to be reused across requests.
learnMore: Prompt caching for faster model inference - Amazon Bedrock
Nova Micro - Amazon Bedrock

questions.questionText: A company needs to ensure that its Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system retrieves every relevant document for user queries, without omitting important information. Which metric should the company monitor?
questions.explanation: Recall measures how completely a retrieval system finds the relevant documents. A high recall value means few relevant documents are missed; precision instead focuses on limiting irrelevant retrieved documents, while mean reciprocal rank focuses on the position of the first relevant result. AWS documentation describes recall as a measure of result completeness and notes that high recall returns most relevant results.
learnMore: Custom classifier metrics - Amazon Comprehend
Use metrics to understand RAG system performance - Amazon Bedrock

questions.questionText: What does an AI practitioner do in the deployment phase of a generative AI model lifecycle?
options: A. Chooses the most useful and varied data to train the model
B. Sets up and optimizes AWS infrastructure for the live production environment
C. Makes the model available in a live environment for end users to access
D. Continuously trains the model on new data to improve accuracy
questions.explanation: Deployment releases a generative AI model into a live environment so end users can access and use it.

questions.topic: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
questions.questionText: A financial company plans to use generative AI (GenAI) tools in multiple departments. Before using these tools, the company must create a strong AI-governance foundation to support responsible, compliant adoption. Which solution meets these requirements?
options: A. Begin developing and testing GenAI systems. Create governance policies as needed.
B. Deploy technical monitoring tools to track AI system outputs.
C. Assemble a cross- functional team to develop clear policies and guidelines for AI use, oversight, and compliance.
D. Hire external consultants to audit all AI systems.
questions.explanation: Organization-wide AI governance requires clear policies, defined oversight, and documented management of legal and regulatory requirements before AI use. A cross-functional team is positioned to establish guidance that integrates business, technical, risk, legal, and compliance perspectives across departments.
learnMore: NIST AI RMF Playbook — Govern
NIST AI RMF Core

questions.questionText: A company wants to use a large language model (LLM) in its internal AI assistant. The company wants to customize the LLM by using medical papers to familiarize it with medical topics. Which technique meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: Continuous pre-training further trains an existing LLM on a large corpus of unlabeled, domain-specific text, enabling it to acquire specialized knowledge and terminology. Medical papers are an appropriate domain corpus for this technique; supervised learning instead requires labeled input-output examples.
learnMore: Continued pre-training (CPT) - Amazon Nova

questions.questionText: A company is building its first generative AI (GenAI) application and wants to establish a responsible AI policy before moving to production. The company is concerned about explainability and transparency when selecting models for the application. Which techniques or tools address these concerns? Choose two
questions.explanation: Model evaluation supports informed, explainable model selection by measuring model behavior and performance against relevant criteria. AI model service cards provide transparent documentation of a model’s intended use, machine-learning approach, performance considerations, and responsible-use limitations. AWS lists model cards and Amazon Bedrock Model Evaluations as tools for identifying transparent and explainable models.
